picks.editorial_note: An $874 million federal commitment to seven companies under the CHIPS and Science Act is a major bet on strengthening the domestic compute supply chain that underpins all AI research and deployment.

picks.editorial_note: UC Davis's brain-computer interface let an ALS patient speak again in his own voice — a rare, tangible demonstration of AI directly restoring human capability rather than just accelerating research.
picks.title: Giving People Their Voice

picks.editorial_note: Six years and $511 million in AI research funding at a single university shows the scale institutional AI investment has reached, offering a benchmark for how deeply AI is now embedded in higher education.
picks.title: AI year in review

picks.editorial_note: Texas A&M's entry into the DOE's Genesis Mission exemplifies the flagship national push to unite government, industry, and academia around AI, supercomputing, and quantum systems for scientific discovery.
picks.title: Texas A&M University joins the Genesis Mission to transform science using artificial intelligence – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: RPI's two Genesis Mission awards, including AI-guided rare-earth materials discovery with a national lab, show the initiative translating into concrete, high-value scientific projects rather than just funding announcements.
picks.title: RPI Selected for Two U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission Projects

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's deployment of the first AI-driven telescope marks a genuine technical first, demonstrating how autonomous AI systems can directly reshape scientific instrumentation and discovery.
picks.title: First AI-driven telescope goes stargazing

picks.editorial_note: A $21.5 million NSF AI Institute spanning five universities to advance human-AI collaboration in rehabilitation and health care represents a significant multi-institution bet on applied AI for clinical care.

picks.editorial_note: William & Mary's Genesis Mission award to build AI foundation models for particle physics, in partnership with major national labs, pushes AI into fundamental physics research at scale.
picks.title: William & Mary receives DOE Genesis Mission award to advance AI-powered particle physics

picks.editorial_note: An $18 million, six-year NSF MRSEC grant to Nebraska for quantum materials research underscores sustained federal investment in the materials science feeding next-generation, energy-efficient AI hardware.
picks.title: Husker team earns elite NSF award to drive next generation of materials research
